title: Promise
overview: Promise is an upcoming Indian Tamil-language drama film directed by Arunkumar Sekaran and produced by Narayana Nagaraj. The screenplay is written by Arunkumar Sekaran, with additional writing by Sujan Christopher. The film stars Arunkumar Sekaran, Amrish, Gokul, Pratap, Kumar Raj, Nadiya Somu, Nathiya Somu, Sujan, and Sundaravel. The music is composed by Deepan Saravana, cinematography is handled by Vinothkumar DFT, and editing is by Sriram Vignesh. The film explores themes of relationships, emotions, trust, and the power of keeping one's promises. Scheduled for release in 2026, Promise is a Tamil drama produced in India.
